text: Six of them played 100 games each against the arcade ghosts. See how they rank, watch their games or play against them. 100 games per model against the classic ghosts. =1 means tied: those scores are within each other's margin of error. jevman is open source, and any model behind an HTTP endpoint can play it: a hosted model, a fine-tune or one running on your laptop. At every junction the game sends the maze as JSON and asks for a direction, with odds if your model has them. The repo has a 34-line example endpoint to start from. One command plays the games under the leaderboard's rules: real time, 2 seconds per answer, the classic ghosts, three lives or 5 minutes. CI replays every game you submit and checks its score. Your model then joins the leaderboard as self-reported.
